description: This PHP source file implements the Symfony polyfill for ctype functions using regex, defining a final class Ctype with static methods for character type checks.

classes.name: Ctype
classes.description: Implementations of ctype functions through regex within the Symfony polyfill repository.

methods.name: ctype_alnum
methods.description: Checks if all characters in input are alphanumeric (letters or digits).

methods.name: ctype_alpha
methods.description: Checks if all characters in input are alphabetic letters.

methods.name: ctype_cntrl
methods.description: Checks if all characters are control characters based on ASCII range.

methods.name: ctype_digit
methods.description: Checks if all characters are decimal digits.

methods.name: ctype_graph
methods.description: Checks if all characters are printable and visible (no whitespace).

methods.name: ctype_lower
methods.description: Checks if all characters are lowercase letters.

methods.name: ctype_print
methods.description: Checks if all characters are printable including whitespace.

methods.name: ctype_punct
methods.description: Checks if all characters are punctuation symbols.

methods.name: ctype_space
methods.description: Checks if all characters are whitespace characters.

methods.name: ctype_upper
methods.description: Checks if all characters are uppercase letters.

methods.name: ctype_xdigit
methods.description: Checks if all characters are hexadecimal digits.

methods.name: convert_int_to_char_for_ctype
methods.description: Converts integer values to their character equivalents for ctype checking, considering ASCII extension.
